venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU — 11 personnel, short throws, nickel
dek: Charted from the 20-minute cut plus the official play list. Faulkner’s card is 12. Philo’s snaps are shotgun 11, first down to Baugh, then hitch and fade. White’s nickel sits off. FAU threw short 46 times.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — 20:11 SEC condensed + official play list. Broadcast, not All-22. Personnel is every pre-snap we could see, not a 67-snap All-22 count. Charles has not approved publish. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Faulkner’s starters are 12. Philo’s snaps are 11 — shotgun, three wide, Baugh. First down is the run. The throw is hitch, then fade, then one go. White plays nickel and sits off. FAU’s 34 catches are the short game. Not explosives.

offense.body:
The depth chart is 12: Baugh, Jackson, Dippre, Singleton, Wilson. Two tight ends. Two receivers. That is the heavier card.

Philo’s snaps on this cut are 11. One back. One tight end. Three wide. Shotgun. 2x2 or trips. Play clock in single digits when they are set — they huddle. The one snap that is not shotgun is the sneak, 4th-and-1, under center. The one snap with nobody in the backfield is 4th-and-goal from the 3: empty, edges climb, Philo keeps.

First down, Philo’s unit: 15 runs, 10 throws. Nine of those runs are Baugh. First down is his. Inside zone when he hits the middle. Bounce when the front clogs — the 18, the 61. Power when they are in the red zone — puller, pads, the 6-yard score.

Then the throw. Philo is 16-of-21. Fourteen of those 16 completions are charted short. Hitch to Brown. The 49 is caught at the 50. First man misses. He runs. Wilson’s 15 and 13 are the same family — short, move the sticks. Stockton’s 12 is the pylon fade. Harpring’s 19 is the tight end in the middle, a seam they will use. Clark’s 10 is a drag. Two balls go over the top: Abrams, 63, go route, right sideline, max protect. Brown, 33, same sideline. They take the shot after the run is real. They do not live there.

Brown also runs it — 14 left. That is manufactured, not a gadget they hid. Clark is the second back, not a package. Jones Jr. closes.

This camera cannot give you every RPO or every 12-personnel snap. It can give you the diet. 11. Baugh on first down. Hitch. Fade. One go.
bullets: Card is 12. Philo’s snaps we could see: 11, shotgun. One sneak. One empty keep.
First down, Philo unit: 15 run, 10 pass. Baugh has nine of the runs.
14 of Philo’s 16 completions are short. Hitch (Brown 49 at the 50). Fade (Stockton 12).
Two goes: Abrams 63, Brown 33. After the run. Not the diet.
Harpring seam. Clark drag. Brown as a runner. That is the changeup list.

defense.kicker: Brad White — nickel, four, sit off
defense.body:
White’s starters are a 4-2-5 nickel: Woods and McCray on the edges, Bett and Kalu inside, Graham and Chiles at linebacker, Kanye Clark as the extra DB on the slot, Thornton and Coleman at safety. That is also the look we kept seeing. Four down. Stand-up edges. Two linebackers. Five DBs.

Rush four. Opening 3rd-and-10, empty, he drops into zone and the ball comes out late. Coleman takes it at the 5. Johnson’s INT is the same rule — interior heat, back-foot duck, he high-points it. Two takeaways. Four-man rush. They waited.

The leak is the cushion. ESPN’s own list marks 46 of FAU’s 49 pass plays short. Two deep. One of those two is Valsin, 20, fade, Flowers loses the back line. The other 34 completions sit at 5.2 yards a throw. Hitch. Flat. Out. That is how you give up 25 first downs and still get two interceptions.

Third down they convert 11 of 22. Fourth down 4 of 7 — Hoch and Messer on the short throw, Ervin on 4th-and-1. The points: Ervin, 1-yard, phone booth, packed box, still in. Veltkamp, 7, the edge loses contain. Valsin, 20, the fade.

Graham, 10 tackles — he fills the hole. McCloud is the interior. Bett strips it in the fourth, Myles Johnson falls on it.

The front is right for spread. The short game is how they moved it. Campbell will go hurry-up at the same two spots: the slot and the edge.
bullets: Nickel, 4-2-5. Stand-up edges. Extra DB on the slot. That is the card and the tape.
Rush four. Coleman on the late throw. Johnson on the duck.
46 of 49 FAU pass plays are charted short. Two deep. One is the Valsin fade.
34 catches, 5.2 a throw. Hitch, flat, out. Not bombs.
Points against: phone booth, contain, fade. Graham fills. Bett finishes.

specials.body: They leave the offense out there, then Durkin from 53. 2:06 of the first. Clean. 17–0. No punt. Eleven kickoffs, ten touchbacks.
bullets: Durkin 53 on 4th-and-4. They took the points.

nextWeek.look: Hurry-up shotgun. Florida’s tape is 11 and nickel. First down they will run it. The throw they have to take away is the short one. Slot and edge.
